title: The Warden of the Waystation
openingText: The warden meets you at the gate of the refugee waystation, sleeves rolled, ledger in hand. 'Wizards. Good — or bad, depending. We shelter forty souls and feed thirty of them. Whatever brought you here, I'll ask you plainly: will you help, and what will it cost me?'
dialogueCordial: The Circle remembers its friends. Longer than kings do.
dialogueStrained: I've heard promises before. Show me terms I can hold in my hand.
dialogueHostile: There are children behind that gate. Mind your tone.
dialogueWalkaway: Then we have nothing to discuss. The road is that way.
dialogueAccept: Then it's done, and witnessed under the open sky. Walk safely.

terms.description: Provision the waystation from your stores — 20 gold of supplies.
The Circle marks your guild as a friend of the road — word travels between every waystation.
A guide walks you past the flooded fords — 2 steps saved.
A quiet request: the Circle asks a future favor of the guild, to be named when needed.
